submission.name: Receipt Ledger
submission.tagline: Turn a small business receipt pile into a clearer cash flow picture.
submission.inspiration: Student-run market stalls and small vendors often have sales records in one place and purchase receipts somewhere else, making it hard to see what a week of trading actually cost. We combined transaction summaries with receipt scanning to give those records a shared starting point.
submission.what_it_does: Users can upload a receipt image and a CSV of sales or expenses to build a simple weekly view of money in and money out. Gemini extracts likely line items and suggests categories, while a small inventory list can be updated from purchased items; extraction sometimes misses quantities or merges lines.
submission.how_we_built_it: The prototype uses a React and TypeScript frontend with a Node and Express backend and MongoDB persistence. Gemini processes receipt images and CSV headers, while the inventory idea borrows a receipt-to-items flow; the upload view and summary view work, but the inventory update is not reliable for every receipt.
submission.challenges_we_ran_into: Receipts vary in layout and image quality, and Gemini occasionally produces incomplete item details that make inventory counts wrong. We also had limited time to reconcile receipts against sales, so the weekly totals should be treated as an organizer rather than formal bookkeeping.
submission.accomplishments: We connected receipt uploads and transaction files to a basic cash flow screen for a small vendor scenario. We are glad the prototype can turn several awkward inputs into a view that is easier to scan.
submission.what_we_learned: We learned that AI extraction needs a clear review step before data affects totals or inventory. Combining document parsing with ordinary financial records also exposed how many assumptions a simple dashboard can hide.
submission.whats_next: We would add a correction flow for parsed items and improve reconciliation between purchases and sales. Longer term, we would make the export useful for a bookkeeper without presenting the prototype as accounting software.
